integrity: The proof classifies the complete subgroup lattice using irreducibility, determines every subgroup-permutability neighborhood, and sums those exact counts to obtain all relative degrees. Finite computation is used only as an independent replay.
scientific_limitations: The action is required to be irreducible and nontrivial.
The complement is required to have prime order.
The kernel is elementary abelian of rank at least two.
An equivalent formula could exist under alternative affine-Frobenius or subgroup-permutability terminology.
title: Relative subgroup commutativity in irreducible elementary-abelian Frobenius groups
